findings.problem: The voice says "times both sides by five to the power X" in beat 22, but the note "× both sides by 5^x" only appears at the start of beat 23, after the move has finished.
findings.fix: Write the note "× both sides by $5^x$" under {m1} in beat 22, on "times both sides", and drop it from beat 23.

findings.rule: every move says what, how, and why
findings.problem: Line 8 is written whole as beat 22 starts, so "= 1" is on the board before the voice explains it. The 2² also shifts behind 5^x without a word, so a student may wonder why the order changed.
findings.fix: Write line 8 with "= 1" only on "is one" in beat 23, and add a few words in beat 22 such as "keep two squared at the end" so the new order is expected.
